definition.name: Open-fork tester · T6-600 study model
definition.description: Compare two probe points or put the open fork around one insulated AC conductor.

parts.name: Insulated grip and finger guard
parts.purpose: The raised guard separates the hand grip from the open fork.

parts.name: Open fork
parts.purpose: Seat one insulated core at the bottom of the fork to measure its AC current or its earth-referenced AC voltage.

parts.name: Single reading display
parts.purpose: The display shows the chosen reading and its unit. HOLD freezes the displayed reading.

parts.name: Function dial
parts.purpose: Turn between Off, FieldSense, two-probe voltage, and resistance with continuity.

parts.name: Yellow function button
parts.purpose: In FieldSense, press to switch the display between amps and volts.

parts.name: HOLD button
parts.purpose: Freeze the current reading on screen. Release HOLD to record a new observation.

parts.name: Rear reference contact
parts.purpose: With the black probe docked, the bench can model an earth reference through this contact. A black lead on a bonded earth point is the other reference.

parts.name: Attached probes and storage dock
parts.purpose: The red and black probes compare two electrical points. The black lead also supplies an explicit earth reference in fork-voltage mode.
